payload.title: lift_sandbox_pin has its own judge of 'this path changed against base_sha' (raw on-disk bytes against the base blob id) that disagrees with git's for any file the checkout converts (eol, a smudge filter such as LFS, ident), so a seat that only added a test gets the whole pin refused; it fails closed, and aqua-saas has no eol or filter rules
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:619-632 (the comparison: bytes read from disk, blob id computed with no conversion)
.gitattributes:1-28 (aqua-saas's .gitattributes holds two merge= rules only (:10, :28): no eol, text, filter or ident)
payload.rule_violated: One judge per question: whether a path changed against base_sha is answered once, and for a checkout that converts files the answer must not differ from git's (the same class as ARIA-LOW-970: a repository property the lift's rule does not know)
payload.notes: Registered by the D6-SEC findings clerk from the D6-SEC review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head d460f7917 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: The lift compares each file with the base blob as the checkout writes it (for example git cat-file --filters in the kernel's own repository, with kernel configuration only and never the seat's tree), or it states the limit where the lift is admitted and refuses by a named code that names the conversion. Test: the probe's repository ('*.txt eol=crlf') with a seat that only adds tests/test_calc.py lifts that file, or is refused by the named conversion code.
